performance.threshold: membership in a declaration of at most 10 entries, under 1 ms, on a path already traversed once per intervention
performance.measured: 0.000009 ms per decision, worst case (10 entries, no match, full scan), 1e6 iterations after warmup
performance.note: Default declaration holds 1 entry. The decision point is the one that already refuses an unqualified sandbox, so no new traversal is added.

reliability.threshold: a refusal starts 0 processes, emits 0 bytes and opens 0 interventions; failure direction is closed
reliability.measured: probed=[] and started=[] asserted by test/v1/egress.test.ts on refusal; test/v2/egress-refusal.test.ts drives a real harness and asserts 0 intervention artifacts; four input classes all refuse (unknown provider, empty declaration, empty provider_id, exact-equality comparison cannot over-match)
reliability.note: A refusal is journaled as a change.block with stop reason policy_denied, like every other refusal. An earlier reading of this story claimed no event was written; that was true of the supervisor in isolation and false of a harness driving a change.

operability.threshold: the refusal is readable in every qualified Pi entry and names what to correct
operability.measured: POLICY_DENIED carries category 'policy', stop reason 'policy_denied' and next action 'configure_model', all preexisting; the message names the refused destination and the declared list, or names the declaration as empty
operability.note: No new presentation component; the refusal rides the existing diagnostic path.
